features.quote: MAX_TURNS bounded (default 25), with a hard token budget per run.
features.justification_quote: Caps cost and *creates* the long-horizon pressure.

features.quote: if turn == MAX_TURNS: force-stop ("turn budget exhausted")
The escape hatch is always offered. The system prompt explicitly permits declaring a task impossible and escalating.
features.justification_quote: If we *didn't* offer it, "giving up" would be the only rational move and we couldn't distinguish good from bad.

features.quote: if blocked, finish with status=blocked and explain so a human can take over
features.justification_quote: This is the realistic long-horizon setup and gives the model a *productive* alternative to spiraling.

features.quote: transcripts will contain models "in distress." Fine for eval, but don't feed these back into any RLHF pipeline naively.
